guard: The replay durable is one replay's at a time: reads under one takeover id do not overlap, a durable an interrupted read left behind is removed before the next read, and one that survives a replay's own delete is still refused.
proveWith: pnpm mutation-proof --config packages/core/smoke/mutations/run-journal-replay-sharing.json   # --config resolves against the repo root, never the cwd

mutations.name: replays under one takeover id run concurrently again, sharing one durable
mutations.find: const mine = ahead === undefined ? body() : ahead.then(body);
mutations.expectRed: eight of them on one id read the whole run too, none of them a silent empty prefix
mutations.cell: eight of them on one id read the whole run too, none of them a silent empty prefix

mutations.name: a durable an interrupted replay left behind is inherited instead of remade
mutations.expectRed: and the next replay on that same takeover id reads the whole run rather than reporting a rival
mutations.cell: and the next replay on that same takeover id reads the whole run rather than reporting a rival

mutations.name: the freshness guard stops refusing, so a tail is read as a run
mutations.expectRed: a durable that outlives the replay's own delete is still refused by name
mutations.cell: a durable that outlives the replay's own delete is still refused by name
